verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a Bolt feature for scheduling recurring jobs, cron tasks, or timed workflows. Supabase edge functions and the ability to run Node.js servers are developer building blocks or third-party capabilities, not a first-party scheduler. Scheduling is a fair question for an AI app-building platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
